semantics: Combinational Moore transition/output equations inspected from one-hot table. A=state[0], B=state[1], C=state[2], D=state[3].
numeric_widths: All Boolean equation operands and results are 1 bit; state vectors are 4 bits. No arithmetic.
latency_reset: Combinational settling only; no clock, reset or stored state.
specification_ambiguities: Only one-hot states are specified as legal. For other encodings, implement the derived bit equations directly without recovery logic.
verification_plan: Compile with explicit dev_tb top using Icarus -g2012 -Wall.
Check all 32 combinations of state and input with a table-based per-active-state reference, including all eight legal transitions.
Check output equals D bit and test input/state mutations for combinational response.
